title: EmbSIM register description
description: An MCU's peripheral registers for the register file (SPEC-006 §5, SPEC-009 §5): peripherals at their base addresses, registers at offsets with reset values, fields with their access in the reference manuals' notation, and the interrupt table. Converted from CMSIS-SVD by tools/importers/svd2regs.py or written from a reference manual.

source.description: The document the description was written from, or the file it was converted from

interrupts.description: Interrupt names to their numbers (0 is the first external interrupt: ARM exception 16)

vectors.description: Interrupt names to the vector each is taken through, where requests share vectors (a PIC32MX's UART error, receive and transmit requests are its one vector); without it, an interrupt's vector is its number

pins.description: A part's pin functions by name to the port pin each is on (CN15: RD6), for models that find a function's pin (change notices, a peripheral's own pins)

pps_outputs.description: A part's Peripheral Pin Select output functions by name to the number an RPORx field selects them with (U2TX: 5)

config_words.description: A part's configuration words by name to their address in program memory (FOSCSEL: 0x0ABF18), for the models that read them at reset (a PIC24's oscillator)

derived_from.description: A peripheral whose registers this one has at its own base

clr_set_inv.description: A PIC32's: the register has CLR, SET and INV registers at +4, +8 and +0xC, where a write clears, sets or inverts the bits written as 1

fields.description: [name, lsb, width] or [name, lsb, width, access]; without fields the register is one read-write field
